description_excerpt: Job Description About us: Our product DM-TL (Diagnostic Module - Tank Leakage) is an automotive product used to detect leaks in vehicle’s fuel evaporative system, which covers various technical domains, such as ECU, software, calibration, and product/components engineering. Our team in Bosch Automotive R&D Center (Ho Chi Minh City) is part of the international development network to lead and support the product development and design topics.
